contradictions.what: Rep says we were the favourite until Halima's remark, but the CTO who favored us did not decide and Halima decided alone.
Rep assumed the load test had won it, but the decider's only reaction to it was 'good' and she wanted something else.
Questions shifted to 'who' after the competitor meeting, yet the rep says we were the favourite until the support-plan moment.
Rep says we were the better platform, but the decider said she does not buy uptime or platform quality.
